nodes.label: Moto G86
nodes.rationale: Works because it presents MTP as vendor-specific, which ptpcamerad ignores.

nodes.label: Android 'No data transfer' USB mode (18d1:4ee7)
nodes.rationale: USB debugging only adds ADB; File transfer must be selected; Developer options Default USB configuration can make it stick.

nodes.label: ptpcamerad (macOS Photos/Image Capture daemon)
nodes.rationale: Claims class-6 Still Image MTP interfaces on plug-in; launchd relaunches it within a second.

nodes.label: Release 1.0.1
nodes.rationale: Shipped the Redmi/ptpcamerad fix; make-dmg.sh now writes straight into site/downloads and dist/ was deleted.

nodes.label: libmtp failed-open USB handle leak fix
nodes.norm_label: libmtp failed-open usb handle leak fix
nodes.rationale: init_ptp_usb could fail after libusb_open without closing, so each Retry leaked a handle and ioreg showed the app itself as owner.

nodes.label: ptpcamerad takeover: SIGKILL then reopen within 0.5 s
nodes.norm_label: ptpcamerad takeover: sigkill then reopen within 0.5 s
nodes.rationale: Once the app holds the interface ptpcamerad can't reclaim it; cost is Photos/Image Capture can't import until unplug or quit. User declined an explicit Connect button.

nodes.label: Remove FORCE_RESET_ON_CLOSE from Android defaults
nodes.rationale: USB reset on session close dropped the Redmi to No data transfer on every quit; verified with five open/close cycles.

nodes.label: PLAN.md phased production plan
nodes.rationale: Phases 0-6 ordered by risk; library build/bundling first because it is the biggest risk

nodes.label: Conversation: MTP Tool v1 build session
nodes.norm_label: conversation: mtp tool v1 build session

nodes.label: macOS 12 deployment target
nodes.rationale: Xcode 27 cannot target macOS 11

nodes.label: Swift bird mark in cyan-to-blue gradient circle
nodes.norm_label: swift bird mark in cyan-to-blue gradient circle

nodes.label: vercel.json .dmg content-disposition header breaks 404s
nodes.rationale: Header rules match missing paths too, so Chrome rejected the 404 with ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE; rule removed.

nodes.label: Versioned DMG filenames
nodes.rationale: Avoids stale caches and identifies the build in Downloads/bug reports.

nodes.label: Use Button instead of onTapGesture
nodes.rationale: Buttons get correct accessibility traits automatically

nodes.label: Prefer Dynamic Type / ScaledMetric over fixed font sizes
nodes.norm_label: prefer dynamic type / scaledmetric over fixed font sizes
nodes.rationale: Respect user font-size accessibility settings

nodes.label: Icon-only buttons need a text label (labelStyle iconOnly)
nodes.norm_label: icon-only buttons need a text label (labelstyle icononly)
nodes.rationale: VoiceOver reads nothing for image-only buttons; keeping text preserves visual while staying accessible

nodes.label: Use foregroundStyle() instead of foregroundColor()
nodes.rationale: foregroundColor is deprecated

nodes.label: Automatic grammar agreement via inflect: true
nodes.norm_label: automatic grammar agreement via inflect: true
nodes.rationale: Lets the system pluralize correctly instead of hand-coded plurals

nodes.label: Prefer overlay(alignment:content:) over overlay(_:alignment:)
nodes.rationale: Old variant deprecated

nodes.label: Never use 1-parameter onChange()
nodes.rationale: Single-parameter variant is deprecated

nodes.label: Avoid Binding(get:set:) in body; use onChange
nodes.norm_label: avoid binding(get:set:) in body; use onchange
nodes.rationale: Manual bindings are fragile and hard to maintain

nodes.label: @Observable classes marked @MainActor with @State/@Bindable/@Environment
nodes.rationale: Replaces ObservableObject/@Published; main-actor isolation avoids data races

nodes.label: Use ContentUnavailableView for empty states
nodes.rationale: Standard system styling over custom designs

nodes.label: Shared enum of design constants
nodes.rationale: Keeps fonts, colors, spacing uniform and easily adjustable

nodes.label: NavigationStack + navigationDestination(for:)
nodes.rationale: NavigationView and NavigationLink(destination:) are deprecated; mixing them breaks navigation

nodes.label: Prefer sheet(item:) for optional data
nodes.rationale: Safely unwraps the optional

nodes.label: Move sorting/filtering out of body
nodes.rationale: body is called frequently, so repeated work there is costly

nodes.label: Prefer task() over onAppear() for async work
nodes.norm_label: prefer task() over onappear() for async work
nodes.rationale: task() cancels automatically when the view disappears

nodes.label: Ternary modifiers over if/else view branches
nodes.norm_label: ternary modifiers over if/else view branches
nodes.rationale: Avoids _ConditionalContent and preserves structural identity

nodes.label: Avoid force unwraps and force try
nodes.norm_label: avoid force unwraps and force try
nodes.rationale: Crash risk; prefer if let/guard/try?

nodes.label: Never use GCD; use Swift concurrency
nodes.norm_label: never use gcd; use swift concurrency
nodes.rationale: Modern async/await, actors and Task are safer under strict concurrency

nodes.label: Don't silently swallow user-action errors
nodes.rationale: Users need an alert, not a print()

nodes.label: Task.detached() is often a bad idea
nodes.norm_label: task.detached() is often a bad idea
nodes.rationale: Loses actor context and priority; check usage carefully

nodes.label: Always pass a value to animation()
nodes.norm_label: always pass a value to animation()
nodes.rationale: Value-less animation() is deprecated and animates unpredictably

nodes.label: Extract subviews into separate View structs
nodes.norm_label: extract subviews into separate view structs
nodes.rationale: Computed some View properties don't help SwiftUI diffing; dedicated views do

nodes.label: One type per Swift file
nodes.rationale: Maintainability and consistent project structure

nodes.label: Nav glide motion
nodes.rationale: CSS smooth scroll was too fast; deliberate ease-in-out lets visitors see the page travel.

nodes.label: CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS: NO (Release)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise ad-hoc Release builds ship get-task-allow.

nodes.label: DEVICE_FLAG_NO_USB_RESET (0x1000)
nodes.rationale: One libusb_reset_device leaves the CT10 failing every OpenSession until replugged.

nodes.label: ptpcamerad interface takeover
nodes.rationale: Class-6 phones (Redmi A5) get claimed by ptpcamerad; DeviceManager.open SIGKILLs it and reopens.

nodes.label: Color tokens (graphite/paper + single amber)
nodes.rationale: Amber always means signal, never warnings.

nodes.label: App icon (graphite squircle, cable, amber LED)
nodes.norm_label: app icon (graphite squircle, cable, amber led)

nodes.label: Typography (Instrument Serif/Sans, Geist Mono)
nodes.rationale: Serif headlines give a liner-notes feel; self-hosted fonts keep the no-network promise.

nodes.label: v1 goals (free, arm64, self-contained)
nodes.rationale: macOS has no native MTP; existing tools are paywalled or flaky on Apple Silicon.

nodes.label: Competitor analysis vs CT10
nodes.rationale: All competitors USB-reset the CT10 (on close or failed open), leaving it unusable until replugged; upload cancel is the second shared bug.

nodes.label: Phase 0: Foundations & de-risking
nodes.rationale: Prove bundled MTP stack talks to the CT10 before building UI.

nodes.label: Post-v1 backlog (FSKit, Developer ID, Sparkle, Wi-Fi MTP)
nodes.norm_label: post-v1 backlog (fskit, developer id, sparkle, wi-fi mtp)

nodes.label: DMG Read Me First install note
nodes.norm_label: dmg read me first install note
nodes.rationale: macOS 15+ removed right-click Open for unsigned apps; uses Privacy & Security Open Anyway.

nodes.label: Fast listing via GetObjPropList (ptp_object_want_children)
nodes.rationale: Six single-property requests per folder: 920-file folder 7.3 s -> 0.39 s; single properties because 'all properties' breaks on CT10's older Android stack.

nodes.label: LGPL dynamic linking of libmtp/libusb
nodes.rationale: Both libraries are LGPL; dylibs in Contents/Frameworks keep the app compliant. Never link statically.

nodes.label: libmtp-ct10.patch
nodes.rationale: Essential: stock libmtp USB-resets Android devices and mishandles cancel, wedging the CT10 and Redmi A5.

nodes.label: No USB reset on close for Android
nodes.norm_label: no usb reset on close for android
nodes.rationale: FORCE_RESET_ON_CLOSE removed from DEVICE_FLAGS_ANDROID_BUGS; reset dropped Redmi A5 out of File transfer mode.

nodes.label: Upload cancel fix (1 s wait + ZLP)
nodes.norm_label: upload cancel fix (1 s wait + zlp)
nodes.rationale: Without it Android f_mtp swallows the next command as object data (60 s stall); GET_DEVICE_STATUS polling wedged the Redmi A5.

nodes.label: Removed Android-flag override hunk (Samsung/Pixel regression)
nodes.rationale: Hunk skipped Android defaults for devices with own entries, silently changing Samsung Galaxy and Pixel behaviour; no longer needed for CT10.

nodes.label: App AccentColor #A8620A
nodes.rationale: White selected-row text on #F2A33A is 2.1:1; #A8620A gives 4.75:1.

nodes.label: The faceplate aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Reads as audio gear for audiophiles; competitors are generic blue/green.

nodes.label: Hero app window drawn in HTML/CSS (.appwin)
nodes.norm_label: hero app window drawn in html/css (.appwin)
nodes.rationale: Sharp at any zoom, themable, can show transfer bars; generic names only.

nodes.label: Unsigned DMG distribution from own website
nodes.norm_label: unsigned dmg distribution from own website
nodes.rationale: Keeps costs at zero; no $99/year Developer ID.

nodes.label: Nav smooth-scroll glide script
nodes.rationale: Eased 0.9-1.5 s glide so the page visibly travels; instant under Reduce Motion; wheel/touch hands control back.

nodes.label: Hero app window (.appwin, HTML/CSS mock)
nodes.rationale: Drawn in HTML/CSS per DESIGN.md so it stays sharp, matches the page, and shows the two transfer bars; generic names only.

nodes.label: Install steps (Privacy & Security, Open Anyway)
nodes.rationale: App is ad-hoc signed without a paid Developer ID, so macOS Gatekeeper warns on first launch.

nodes.label: Verify & source section (checksums, LGPL sources)
nodes.rationale: LGPL 2.1 requires offering the (modified) library source alongside the binary.

nodes.label: Specs section (USB, transfers, device ops, privacy)
nodes.norm_label: specs section (usb, transfers, device ops, privacy)

nodes.label: Two progress bars (current file + total) with cancel
nodes.norm_label: two progress bars (current file + total) with cancel

nodes.label: Custom 404 page
nodes.rationale: Old DMG links land here after a release replaces the DMG; offers a button to the current DMG.

nodes.label: BrowserView (SwiftUI Table browser)
nodes.rationale: macOS 12 Table lacks row primary action, so double-click is per-cell

nodes.label: DeviceManager
nodes.rationale: Every device stays open with one session; all libmtp calls on one serial queue off main thread

nodes.label: FileOps.swift (create/rename/delete)
nodes.rationale: Delete recurses children-first; rename uses one call for files and folders

nodes.label: Transfers.swift transfer engine
nodes.rationale: Chunked streaming; 500MB at ~16MB/s with ~12-17MB peak memory; partial files never left silently

nodes.label: Cmd-drag to move
nodes.rationale: Default drag copies like Finder from a USB drive, protecting the only copy; Cmd at drag start moves

nodes.label: Recursive folder copy with planning step
nodes.norm_label: recursive folder copy with planning step
nodes.rationale: Albums are folders; .DS_Store and hidden files skipped on upload

nodes.label: Gatekeeper Privacy & Security -> Open Anyway flow
nodes.norm_label: gatekeeper privacy & security -> open anyway flow
nodes.rationale: macOS 15 removed right-click Open for non-Developer-ID apps; only a real browser download sets quarantine

nodes.label: GitHub repo Guru-raghav3245/mtp-tool (private)
nodes.rationale: Private as safe default; public later would host LGPL source

nodes.label: LGPL compliance (dynamic dylibs, bundled licences, source archives)
nodes.norm_label: lgpl compliance (dynamic dylibs, bundled licences, source archives)
nodes.rationale: Modified libmtp shipped, so patched source must be published next to DMG; users can swap and re-sign libraries

nodes.label: Slow per-object folder listing
nodes.rationale: 200 files 1.8s, ~18s for 2000 tracks due to per-object queries on Android

nodes.label: UsbExclusiveOwner contention (MacDroid / Android File Transfer)
nodes.rationale: Other MTP apps take exclusive ownership; app must say 'In use by X'

nodes.label: DEVICE_FLAGS_ANDROID_BUGS runtime OR override
nodes.rationale: libmtp re-adds Android flags at runtime after detecting android.com extension, silently undoing the CT10 table entry; first fix failed because of this

nodes.label: CLEAR_HALT data-toggle fix (reverted)
nodes.rationale: Guess that the debug log did not support; reverted

nodes.label: get-task-allow entitlement removal
nodes.rationale: Xcode injects it into ad-hoc builds unless CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS is off in Release

nodes.label: libmtp-ct10.patch
nodes.rationale: CT10 wedged after every session close; patch collects device-specific fixes (no reset, upload cancel, rename leaks)

nodes.label: libusb pipe2 null-call crash
nodes.rationale: configure picked up weak pipe2 from newer SDK; fixed with ac_cv_func_pipe2=no

nodes.label: LIBMTP_Set_Object_Filename leak fix
nodes.rationale: free() instead of LIBMTP_destroy_file_t and unfreed name copy; 32 bytes per rename

nodes.label: Held-session revalidation on rescan
nodes.rationale: CT10 keeps same USB id after replug; fast replug within 1s debounce could keep a dead session

nodes.label: Upload cancel with zero-length packet
nodes.rationale: Android f_mtp swallowed the next command as object data after cancelled send (64s stall); ZLP completes pending OUT request, cancel drops to ~3.6s

nodes.label: USB reset on close (FORCE_RESET_ON_CLOSE)
nodes.rationale: libmtp resets Android devices on close; CT10 never recovers, every later session fails until replug

nodes.label: Amber accent (#F2A33A site, #A8620A app)
nodes.rationale: Bright amber fails white-text contrast (2.1:1) on macOS selected rows, so the app uses deep amber at 4.75:1; light-mode site link darkened to #9E5C09 (4.7:1).

nodes.label: Competitor research (OpenMTP, MacDroid, Doppler, Audio Hijack, Swinsian)
nodes.norm_label: competitor research (openmtp, macdroid, doppler, audio hijack, swinsian)
nodes.rationale: Competitors are crowded feature dumps in blue/green; audio apps go dark and let the product carry the page.

nodes.label: Debug-only window snapshot hook (PATCHCORD_SNAPSHOT)
nodes.rationale: Lets the app save its own window image without Screen Recording permission.

nodes.label: design-consultation skill run
nodes.rationale: Answers 1A 2A 3A 4A: audiophiles, 'it just works', research first, redesign icon.

nodes.label: design-html skill (skip design-shotgun)
nodes.rationale: design-shotgun needs an OpenAI image key; design-html is Claude writing HTML/CSS directly.

nodes.label: Serif device name as device switcher menu
nodes.norm_label: serif device name as device switcher menu
nodes.rationale: Chevron made part of text because macOS menus put icons before text.

nodes.label: Finder-style round cancel X
nodes.rationale: Esc deliberately not bound to cancel to avoid aborting long uploads.

nodes.label: Name candidates (Pilot Light, Tonearm, Line Level, Patchcord, Interconnect)
nodes.norm_label: name candidates (pilot light, tonearm, line level, patchcord, interconnect)
nodes.rationale: Patchbay, Headroom, Tally Light, Needledrop found taken; Patchcord checked free and later chosen.

nodes.label: Eased ~1 s nav scroll glide
nodes.rationale: Native smooth scroll is too fast and not tunable; skipped under Reduce motion; interrupts on user scroll.

nodes.label: Two progress bars (current file + batch total by bytes)
nodes.norm_label: two progress bars (current file + batch total by bytes)
nodes.rationale: Bytes not file count so a large FLAC counts more and the bar moves steadily; sizes from the planning step.

nodes.label: Instrument Serif / Instrument Sans / Geist Mono
nodes.norm_label: instrument serif / instrument sans / geist mono
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted (not Google Fonts) to match the no-network promise; OFL licenses shipped alongside.

nodes.label: design-review of live site (FINDING-001..005)
nodes.rationale: Gutters alignment, 44px tap targets, light-mode amber contrast, distinct source link text, 404 alignment; B+ to A-.

nodes.label: Release 1.0.2
nodes.rationale: Faceplate redesign, two bars + cancel X, cancel undo, no reset on close; DMG 1.4 MB with bundled fonts.

nodes.label: swiftui-pro SwiftUI review of ContentView
nodes.rationale: Findings kept as a to-do in CLAUDE.md; rules needing macOS 13/14 skipped because the app targets macOS 12.

nodes.label: Graphite squircle icon with cable and amber light
nodes.norm_label: graphite squircle icon with cable and amber light
nodes.rationale: Replaced Apple's icon-template placeholder; drawn by scripts/make-icon.py.

nodes.label: App UI rebuilt in website faceplate style
nodes.norm_label: app ui rebuilt in website faceplate style
nodes.rationale: Reverses DESIGN.md's 'app stays native' rule at user request; macOS 12 Table background/header can't be styled.

nodes.label: Rename away from 'MTP Tool'
nodes.rationale: User dislikes 'tool'; competitor names use Droid/Android/MTP (trademark risk, jargon); name should come from audio gear.

nodes.label: Cancel undoes the whole batch
nodes.rationale: Only deletes what the batch created; pre-existing names are refused at planning. Verified via CLI --cancel-after on CT10.

nodes.label: Faceplate design language
nodes.rationale: Graphite/paper, engraved mono labels, one amber indicator light: the language of hardware that works; serif headlines add audiophile care.

nodes.label: No real device/folder/song names on the site
nodes.norm_label: no real device/folder/song names on the site
nodes.rationale: User request; hero uses Music Player, Music > Album, Track 01.flac.

nodes.label: HTML/CSS-drawn app window in site hero
nodes.norm_label: html/css-drawn app window in site hero
nodes.rationale: Sharp at any zoom, uses page fonts, shows transfer features, 113 KB lighter; must be kept in sync with the app.

nodes.label: Row click selection fix (simultaneous per-cell gestures)
nodes.norm_label: row click selection fix (simultaneous per-cell gestures)
nodes.rationale: Per-cell double-click/drag handlers swallowed clicks so rows sometimes didn't highlight amber.

nodes.label: Table re-sorts entries in body on every progress tick
nodes.norm_label: table re-sorts entries in body on every progress tick
nodes.rationale: Sort once in load() and onChange(of: sortOrder) instead; a folder can hold 2,000 files.

nodes.label: Task.detached + blocking mtp.sync ties up cooperative pool threads
nodes.norm_label: task.detached + blocking mtp.sync ties up cooperative pool threads
nodes.rationale: Resume a checked continuation from mtp.async instead; CLI keeps sync list.

nodes.label: Icon-only buttons lack VoiceOver labels
nodes.rationale: Use Label + .labelStyle(.iconOnly); later applied in the faceplate rewrite.

nodes.label: Patchcord App Icon Design
nodes.rationale: Dark rounded-square faceplate with fine vertical brushed texture; an off-white cable loops back into a right-pointing arrow ending in a USB plug (transfer over a patch cord), with a glowing amber LED dot top-right echoing the app's faceplate/LED look. Same image rendered at 16-1024px because macOS ignores a single 1024 image.
